content.comment_body: Hello, I need 24 [product_name] modules for my machines. I'm wondering if there is any [product_name] operator device that could control all 24 units from one panel.
Please refer to the attachment, section 2.1.1.

A [product_name] operator panel can only communicate with one [product_name] module directly. In a [product_name] network, a maximum of 16 components are possible for direct communication. You can send signals in virtual mode from one [product_name] module to another, allowing you to collect signals from your 23 modules and send them to the 24th one, which then connects to the operator panel. While this is possible, it is not highly reliable. It is generally better to use a real HMI panel for this purpose. With an HMI, you can send all signals from all your modules to one HMI screen.

analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks a centralized solution to manage 24 [product_name] modules using a single [product_name] operator device. Community responses explain that direct control with one operator device is limited to a single module and that the network has restrictions. Alternatives involving indirect control exist but are not optimal; the recommended approach is to use an HMI panel for more reliable centralized control.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to find an efficient method to centrally control all 24 [product_name] units with a single operator device.
